items.title: EU lawmakers find “clearly diverging” accounts of Amazon warehouse work
items.summary: After a two-day fact-finding mission to Amazon warehouses in Germany and Poland, Members of the European Parliament (MEPs) from the Committee on Employment and Social Affairs (EMPL) found “clearly diverging assessments” of working conditions at Amazon between workers and management, according to the committee’s mission report published last week. items.title: Commerce unions from 45 countries meet in Bangkok to shape the future – together
items.summary: Over 250 trade union leaders from 45 countries will gather in Bangkok, Thailand, from 1 to 3 December 2026 for the UNI Commerce Global Conference. items.title: Unemployment Insurance Weekly Claims Report
items.summary: In the week ending November 21, the advance figure for seasonally adjusted initial claims was 189,000, a decrease of 13,000 from the previous week's revised level. The previous week's level was revised down by 1,000 from 203,000 to 202,000. The 4-week moving average was 196,000, a decrease of 1,500 from the previous week's revised average. The previous week's average was revised down by 250 from 197,750 to 197,500.
